Notes on pricing and commercial structure for the addendum (DEAL-3421):
- EU residency addendum: bill as a 10% uplift on hosted token pricing plus a one-time residency enablement fee (we've typically used $12k for region onboarding).
- APAC pilot: recommend offering a 3-month pilot with reserved burst capacity pricing (25% discount on standard burst rates) and option to convert to Dedicated pool at renewal.

Folks,

Technical constraints / timeline:
- EU residency addendum: we can scope this as region-specific model routing + storage residency. Expect a 2-3 week lead time for configuration & compliance paperwork (KMS key mapping + audit logs).
- APAC onramp: for a pilot using Hosted+Burst we need 2 weeks to provision regional pools and 1 week for smoke testing with customer's traffic. If they want Private (VPC) option, add 4-6 weeks for network setup & KMS exchange.
- Cross-region failover: routing policy tests + DR runbook validation ~1 week; note that cross-region KV cache warm-up will increase cold token latency on first failover. We'll include a runbook statement and an observed RTO/RPO range.

I'll draft a high-level implementation schedule to include in the SOW.
